# regru_zone (Data Source)

Reads the zone's SOA settings, reg.ru service details, and current DNS records.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "regru_zone" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Zone name, e.g. `example.com`.

### Read-Only

- `records` (Attributes List) List of DNS records currently configured for the zone. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))
- `service_id` (String) Numeric identifier of the internal reg.ru service associated with the domain.
- `service_type` (String) Internal reg.ru service type. This is normally `domain`.
- `soa` (Attributes) Start of Authority (SOA) record settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--soa))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `content` (String) Record content: an IPv4 address for `A` records, an IPv6 address for `AAAA` records, a target domain for `CNAME` records, and so on.
- `name` (String) Subdomain name, `*` for a wildcard, or `@` for the zone apex.
- `priority` (Number) Record priority.
- `type` (String) Record type: `A`, `AAAA`, `CAA`, `CNAME`, `MX`, `NS`, `SRV`, or `TXT`.


<a id="nestedatt--soa"></a>
### Nested Schema for `soa`

Read-Only:

- `minimum_ttl` (String) Zone negative-cache time to live, specified in seconds or with a unit suffix: `m` for months, `w` for weeks, `d` for days, or `h` for hours.
- `ttl` (String) Zone time to live, specified in seconds or with a unit suffix: `m` for months, `w` for weeks, `d` for days, or `h` for hours.
